Unambiguous (codes 1-4, n=143): 138 have numeric Q434bCost (77 per single trip, 42 per return trip, 16 per week, 3 per month); 5 have a real weekly/monthly/etc. payment period but Q434bCost itself is Unspecified (ambiguous). DISPUTED (n=80, codes 5-6): the fielded instrument's own printed category list for Q433bPay (page 38 of the CAPI export) shows only 6 options -- per single/return/week/month, then code 5=DO NOT PAY, code 6=DO NOT KNOW -- and Q434bCost's enabling condition (page 39) is explicitly gated on Q433bPay in (1,2,3,4), consistent with codes 5-6 needing no cost value. But the .dta's attached value-label dictionary decodes Q433bPay codes 5/6 as 'Per year'/'Package trips, buying points' instead. The sibling driver-pay question Q315Pay (identical instrument design, same 6-option list) carries CORRECTLY matching labels (5=Do not pay, 6=Do not know) in the same .dta, which is evidence the Q433bPay label set was mismatched during data processing rather than the instrument's printed category list being truncated. NOT resolved: see transport_definition.md for both scenarios. Scenario A (labels as exported): 70 'per year' + 10 'package trips' = 80 genuine nonresponse. Scenario B (labels mismatched, instrument as printed governs): 70 reclassify as legitimate zero fares (do not pay), 10 reclassify as nonresponse (payment period itself unknown).

Journey-level classification across all four reported travel legs (Q429b-Q432b block), not leg-1-only. 141 people report 'do not pay' on every administered leg (legitimate zero fare). 2,256 have at least one leg with a usable numeric cost -- this includes 2,238 whose FIRST leg alone carries a numeric cost, plus 18 people whose first leg was reported free but who paid on a later leg of the same journey (e.g. walked/hitched the first stretch, then took a paid minibus taxi) and were wrongly zeroed out by a leg-1-only reading. 7 have a named mode and payment period on some leg but that leg's cost value is 'Unspecified' with no leg reaching a confirmed positive cost (ambiguous). 4 report 'do not know' as the payment period on their only administered leg (nonresponse). Payment-period split of the 2,256 positive journeys' first leg: 1,762 per single trip, 446 per return trip, 20 per week, 9 per month, 1 per year (2 people reported 'per year' on leg 1; one of the two has a numeric leg-1 cost, the other's leg-1 cost is Unspecified and is counted in the ambiguous total instead), plus the 18 positive-on-a-later-leg cases.

Base case (Scenario A for the disputed driver codes): 2,165 of 4,655 (46.5%) legitimate zero fares (1,997 walk + 27 cycle + 141 hitchhike/listed-mode journeys); 2,394 of 4,655 (51.4%) have at least one leg with a usable numeric cost (138 drivers + 2,256 hitchhike/listed-mode journeys); 12 of 4,655 (0.3%) are ambiguous (named mode/period, unspecified cost: 5 drivers + 7 hitchhike/listed-mode); 84 of 4,655 (1.8%) are confirmed nonresponse under Scenario A (80 disputed driver codes 5-6 + 4 hitchhike/listed-mode 'do not know'). Under Scenario B for the disputed driver codes, 70 of those 80 move from nonresponse to legitimate zero fare and 10 stay nonresponse for a different reason (payment period unknown rather than cost unspecified): legitimate zero fares would be 2,235 (48.0%), nonresponse would fall to 14 (0.3%). The payment-period CONVERSION to a common basis, and the choice between Scenario A and B for the disputed driver codes, remain open -- see transport_definition.md. No corrected transport_budget_share value is reported.
